segments.text: As they picked up wins against Persepolis, Al Wasl, Al Rayyan, Al Shorta and Al Ain with three of those games being away matches.
The Iranian side Esteghlal then halted their momentum with a 2-2 draw here at this venue.
They were actually moments away from a big win, but were denied all three points by a late Ivan Toney penalty. That draw proved to be just a minor speed bump for Al Ahli
as they cruised into the round of 16 with back-to-back wins against Qatari clubs Al Sadd who are also at these finals,
they'll be in action tomorrow, and Al Gharafa, with Al Ahli scoring seven goals in those two matches as they wrapped up their league stage fixtures in style.
They would then come up against another Qatari side in the round of 16 with Al Rayyan standing in their way.
